Supplier-stated TDS specific gravity is that manufacturer's own QC value for their specific product grade, not a pycnometric measurement performed by this audit on a physical sample of the catalog's actual purchased material -- it narrows, but does not eliminate, the single-source risk constant-crosscheck-v1 named.
Does not resolve which named commercial sub-grade (e.g. ExBar W1 vs W325 particle cut) the catalog's single unnamed 'barytes' record corresponds to.
Gate is a point-transcription/range-containment tolerance, not a physical admissibility bound; does not establish product qualification or supplier closure.
